title: Cooking timer set
description: A pixel kitchen timer panel with three independent timers (Eggs 6:00, Pasta 9:00, Tea 3:00): each has Start/Pause and Reset, counts down in mm:ss, and shows 'Done!' at zero.

title: Image-free gallery
description: A pixel gallery of 6 CSS-drawn tiles: clicking a tile opens it large in a modal with its title, Previous and Next buttons inside the modal, and Escape or a Close button closes it.

title: Monthly budget
description: A pixel monthly budget: set an income, add expenses with a category (Food, Rent, Fun, Other) and amount, show the remaining money, a bar per category, and turn the remaining amount red when it is negative.

title: Mini maze
description: A pixel maze on a 7x7 grid with fixed walls: move the player with the arrow keys, walls block movement, count steps, and show 'You escaped!' when the player reaches the exit, with a Restart button.

title: Focus log
description: A pixel focus log: type what you worked on and the minutes spent, add it to a list for today, show the total minutes and the longest session, and allow deleting entries.

title: Star rating
description: A pixel product review widget: 5 stars that highlight on hover and set the rating on click, a text box for a comment, a Submit button that adds the review to a list, and the average rating of all reviews.

title: Anagram checker
description: A pixel anagram checker: two text boxes, a Check button that says whether they are anagrams ignoring spaces and letter case, and a list of the last 5 checks with their results.

title: Lamp switchboard
description: A pixel switchboard with 8 labelled switches and matching lamps: each switch turns its lamp on or off, an All on and All off button, and a counter of lamps that are on.
